title: To the People Who Stay
author: Agile Lens
source: Original text created for the Understudy sample pack, October 28, 2026. Not a quotation or a device-readiness claim.

entries.text: Original rehearsal text. Pause and resume at your own pace.
I will keep this short enough that the ice can survive it.
We often celebrate the person who has the idea. Tonight I want to celebrate the people who stay when the idea becomes work.
The people who bring another chair. The people who ask whether you ate. The people who can tell that your cheerful message means you need help.
You have done that for us, in ways large enough to change a year and small enough that you probably forgot them.
We did not forget. Raise a glass to the time you gave, the room you made, and the next ordinary evening we get to share.
To all of you. Thank you for staying.
